record.reason: RuleFlow converts LLM-discovered per-program Pandas rewrites into reusable compiler rules and reports state-of-the-art results on PandasBench, amortizing repeated LLM calls. Its measured domain is dataframe programs, not model inference kernels or LLM serving; retain only as a weak reusable-optimization/kernel-generation connection.
record.title: RuleFlow : Generating Reusable Program Optimizations with LLMs
